Subject: Re: Phased monthly commit proposal + launch buffer

Evan — good questions, answered inline below. Thanks for taking the call.

1) Launch buffer vs true-up: the buffer is a temporary credit pool applied to the first 30 days after public launch to cover sudden spikes. It is consumed before overage billing applies. Buffer credits do not roll forward; they are meant to be a one-time launch protection (we can set expiry of 60–90 days if you prefer). We also offer quarterly true-ups so you only reconcile actual vs committed usage at the quarter boundary.

2) Overage cap: finance prefers a single, predictable multiplier but we can accommodate a stepped approach: 1.25x for months 1–2 (warm up) then 1.5x thereafter if you want a guaranteed cap for early months. I'll confirm with Laura but this is likely doable.

3) Unit pricing by SKU: embeddings and generation are separate SKUs in the sheet. Discounts apply to both, but the breakpoint math is SKU-aware (you hit discount tiers per SKU). If you prefer a blended per-token volume discount across SKUs we can propose that as an alternative.

4) Timeline: noted — we'll target a signed SOW and PO by 05/30. I will run the buffer % and early-month cap with finance now and come back with a revised spreadsheet.

Action items from me: update spreadsheet to show a stepped overage cap (1.25x months 1–2, 1.5x after), add a 25–90 dayExpiry option for the launch buffer, and sketch a blended-SKU example. Expect the update by EOD Friday.

Karthik

Attachment: nebula_phased_commit_v1.xlsx (updated tabs: overage-options)
